_comment: Godot-only content. A villager with an entry here gets a '🛍' choice in conversation that opens their shop. requires: {quests, harmony, flags} as in quests.json, for the whole shop or one stock line. buys: money paid per item (coins inside, shown as lire) when you sell. stock: lines you can buy with coins: items (a bundle, as often as you like), blueprint or clothes (once). likes (in npcs.json) and treat (in resources.json) decide how much a gift raises friendship; giftLines are the generic thank-you lines ({item} is the gift's name).

loved: {item}? For me? This is my favourite!
You know me too well. {item}, how lovely!

bram.name: Fusibile Electrics
bram.label: Let's trade
bram.greet: Wire, lamps, timber and plans. Mind the cables. Some of them are live. Most of them.

fern.name: Ghisolfi Farm Stall
fern.label: Anything for sale?
fern.greet: Hazelnuts, seeds and good advice. The advice is free; the trees insist.

tilly.name: Fede's Spare Parts
tilly.label: Show me your spare parts
tilly.greet: Old computer bits, cables, and a CD of shareware. Cash only. My dad says so.

mabel.name: Tealdi Bakery
mabel.label: What's fresh today?
mabel.greet: Bread, cake, and absolutely no boars. Usually. A treat makes a lovely gift, you know.

captain.name: Aldo's Back Seat
captain.label: What's on the bus?
captain.greet: Things passengers left behind. After a year, lost property is mine. That's the law. Probably.

hazel.name: Rivet's Forge
hazel.label: Let's trade
hazel.greet: Gears, springs and plans. Hot off the anvil!
